mixRuleNote: If either Warlord's Duo can use a weapon, status, troop line, tool or resource, the mixed pair can. Import-only stays import-only unless the other side can produce it. Buildings the pair cannot construct stay locked even if resources exist. A blacksmith can still forge imported ingots (e.g. Hardened Steel). Tweak per item later.
signatureRule: Usually one signature per Warlord: a unique troop OR a unique building, not both.

accessStates.import: Import only — can use, cannot produce

images: Images/<Category>/<Exact Name>.jpg — e.g. Images/Warlords/Viktor.jpg, Images/Resources/Steel.jpg, Images/Weapons/Arc Gun.jpg. Any missing image shows a labelled placeholder.
sync: The markdown files in Data/ are the source of truth. Edit them, then ask the assistant to sync a batch into each HTML's DEFAULT_DATA. Quick edits made in a page (Edit → Save into HTML) are stored inside that HTML file and should be copied back into the markdown at the next sync.
images: Images/<Category>/<Exact Name>.jpg. Shortlist variants Name1.jpg, Name2.jpg … — click a picture in any book to cycle; the shown pick saves with Save into HTML.
palette: Duo colour = shared theme; each Warlord has a personal accent; mixed pairs adopt the two Warlord accents. Flags: colony flag, horizontal banner, vertical sash, logo — all use the Duo colour + both accents. Table in Warlords_of_Eden.md.
sharing: Run `node tools/build-share.mjs --desktop` from the repo root. It builds dist/Pages of Eden (Share)/ and a .zip where every HTML is fully self-contained (styles and pictures embedded) plus the design notes, and copies both to the Desktop.
